worldcombat.skill.conversion2.summary: Read the opponent's latest real attack to adjust your protection: against a Pokémon, weave your own type into one that resists that element; against a non-Pokémon, reduce an observed native damage type. Attacks older than the read memory no longer count.
worldcombat.skill.conversion2.use.0: Take a hit whose type you already read
worldcombat.skill.conversion2.use.1: Flip your hit chart onto the side a foe cannot hurt
worldcombat.skill.conversion2.use.2: Change resistance before being pressed down
worldcombat.skill.conversion2.descriptio: Range %1$s blocks, preparation %2$s. Read the foe’s latest direct hit within %3$s. Against a Pokémon, change your own type to resist that hit’s final element, including changes made as it resolved.
Type adaptation against a Pokémon lasts %1$s; current preference: %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.conversion2.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.conversion2.growth.0: From level %1$s the weave lasts %2$s s and the read range is %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.conversion2.preference: On: among the types that resist that move, take the one with the best overall hit chart (fewer weaknesses), good when other moves still fly. Off: take the type that resists that one move the hardest.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of reading. Larger values change type from further away.
When on, the user may leave its post to read a foe; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.conversion2.world: Against another creature, read the native damage type of its latest successful direct hit and gain protection for %1$s. Focused mode reduces that type by 50%. Broad mode reduces it by 25% and, for a physical reading, also covers ordinary melee, arrows, tridents, stings, rams and mace attacks. Old attacks, missed hits and residual damage do not supply a reading. Recasting refreshes this protection.
